fertilizer.title: Fertilizer Trial on Pechay
fertilizer.summary: Growth of pechay under three fertilizer treatments, 15 plants each, measured 30 days after transplanting.
fertilizer.note: Three treatments in a completely randomized design: no fertilizer (Control), vermicompost, and inorganic (14-14-14) fertilizer.
objectives:
What is the growth performance of pechay under each fertilizer treatment in terms of:
1.1 Plant height
1.2 Number of leaves
1.3 Leaf width
1.4 Fresh weight
Is there a significant difference in the growth performance of pechay among the three fertilizer treatments?
Which fertilizer treatment produced the best growth performance?

experiment.summary: Test scores of a control group and a treatment group before and after an intervention.
experiment.note: One posttest score is missing to show how missing data are reported.
objectives: Determine the pretest and posttest scores of the Control and Treatment groups.
Determine whether there is a significant difference in posttest scores between the Control and Treatment groups.
Determine whether there is a significant difference in pretest scores between the Control and Treatment groups.
Determine the relationship between pretest and posttest scores.

survey.title: Survey Data Analysis
survey.summary: Customer-experience survey with demographics, Likert items and scale scores.
survey.note: Scale scores are the means of their 1–5 Likert items (SQ, CS and PI).
objectives: Determine the profile of the respondents in terms of gender, program and year level.
Determine the level of service quality, customer satisfaction and purchase intention.
Determine whether customer satisfaction differs between male and female respondents.
Determine the relationship between service quality, customer satisfaction and purchase intention.
